claims.statement: The rule assigning every active selected leaf tag in each independent (p+1)-set B to a distinct support vertex in N(B) via the B--N(B) incidence graph fails on the exact eligible tree T_22 at p=34: one witnessed B has 33 active tags on 11 distinct supports.
claims.scope: The stated injective support-vertex charging rule, for the single ordinary T_22 instance and independent set recorded in EVIDENCE.json; this is not a claim about all matching/slack mechanisms or the primary aggregate.
claims.reason: The replay checks x=32, a=68, p=34, both strict eligibility guards, the exact fixed favorable set of all 67 original leaves, and a rank-35 independent B with 33 active tags but only 11 support vertices. The complete full sum is negative, so the finding rejects only this injectivity mechanism and does not refute the target inequality.

limitations: The witness tests only a one-tag-per-distinct-support injection; mechanisms with multi-tag support weights or additional slack are not ruled out.
The full aggregate in the witness is negative, and no primary counterexample or proof is established.
The computation covers one explicitly specified tree and makes no universal or census claim.
